canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the Sealed Adit's chapter of the book of lore, its lines the game's; the old mining tunnels and the rail deep down (book2 ch.19), aether-geodes (book1 ch.3), the Cult of Ash (book1 ch.10) and the Silent Pilgrims (world_bible.md) are CANON, as each line says.

entries.subject: The Sealed Adit
entries.line: The old working's mouth in the mountain's flank, walled up from outside and broken open again. The cut runs in under the Peaks further than anyone mapped.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: old mining tunnels under the Shattered Peaks are CANON (book2 ch.19); this working is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Cage Bowl
entries.line: A great bowl of a cave where the Company kept its pressed hands caged between shifts. The cages are still there, and the hooks.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Lusk's Tally Hall
entries.line: Where the gang-boss counted the carts down and the carts up, and docked the pay of every man short.
entries.more: His tally book: carts down, carts up, three lost on the stair and their men's pay docked, two hundred geodes cut, and the pressed hands counted with the carts.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: Lusk and his tally. Aether-geodes are CANON (book1 ch.3).

entries.subject: The Flooded Working
entries.line: An old level the water took back when the miners stopped bailing it. Things live in it now.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Pen
entries.line: Where the Company penned the goblins it worked. Pib remembers it, and will not say more.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Singing Gallery
entries.line: The great cave that sings three notes when the air moves through it.
entries.more: A pilgrim's slate says the miners cut the north door to hear the notes, and that each colour of stone in the halls answers one of them.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Pilgrims are CANON (world_bible.md); the gallery's notes are GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Geode Foundry
entries.line: Where the Company split the aether-geodes and sorted the shards, by hand and chisel, under the lamps.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: aether-geodes are CANON (book1 ch.3); the Company's work here is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Ash Garden
entries.line: A garden of grey ash and stone the Cult raked into patterns, where nothing grows, and that is the point of it.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Cult of Ash is CANON (book1 ch.10); its garden is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Scriptorium
entries.line: Where the Order's copyists wrote out their histories, and a censor struck out what should not be remembered.
entries.more: One page the censor missed: the first of the Order did not come to the fire to worship it. They came because the grey was coming down the valley, and the fire was warm.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the Order and its history. The Cult of Ash and the Wasting are CANON (book1 ch.10).

entries.subject: The Muster Yard
entries.line: Where the Order drilled its zealots in rows, under the eye of its master-at-arms.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Chapel of Embers
entries.line: The Order's fire chapel, deep under the mountain, where the heat comes through the rock of the stair down to it.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Sunless River
entries.line: A river that runs under the mountain in the dark, cold enough to stop the breath. Something lives in its pools.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Grey Breach
entries.line: Where the grey broke into the workings from below, and the stone went smooth and silent.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the void eating through the Peaks' stone is CANON (world_bible.md); the breach is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Deep Way
entries.line: The long road down to the rail, lit by lichen where the lamps gave out.
entries.more: The lamp-men's own mixing card for the gallery oil: rendered mule fat, a little pitch, a fistful of salt against the damp. Warm it, do not boil it.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the lamp-men's card. The old workings' lamps are CANON (book2 ch.19).

entries.subject: The Rail Hall
entries.line: Where the deep line begins: the Company's carriages, its platform, and sleepers stacked like cordwood.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the rail deep under the Peaks is CANON (book2 ch.19); the Company's hall is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Dead Line
entries.line: A spur of the rail that runs to nowhere now.
entries.more: A letter under seal sends forty crates a month along it to the hub at the coast, where the Council's factor weighs them and asks nothing.
entries.canonStatus: PROVISIONAL: the letter is GAME-ONLY; the rail south to a coastal hub is CANON (book2 ch.19).

entries.subject: The Black Cove
entries.line: An underground harbour on black water, with a barge scaffold and moorings, where the Company's crates went out.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Gang-Boss Haddo Lusk
entries.line: The gang-boss of the lower workings, who docks a dead man's pay and counts it as saved.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Old Kettle, the pitch-boiler
entries.line: He boils the pitch for the sleepers and the axles, somewhere past the stacked sleepers. Do not wake him.
entries.more: His chalked tally: fourteen barrels boiled, eleven sent up, three 'lost'. Knock first, it says.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Foreman Who Forgot
entries.line: The Umbra working's foreman, gone grey with his deep level. He still gives orders to nobody.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Quiet Miner
entries.line: A miner who lay down in his drift and went quiet. Some days he is there, and some days he is not.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: herb.last_light
entries.line: Where the fire chapel's heat seeps through the stair's wall, the ash's pale flower grows red and glows like coals.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.

entries.subject: Ember-bound
entries.line: Red, horned things the Order keeps chained by the fire, a spiked collar on each and the chain's end in a keeper's fist. Loosed, they swing the chain before the mace.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY creature; CANON-EXPANDED: the Cult of Ash (book1 ch.10) and its glowing chains and collars (book1 ch.12:19-25)
